definitions.explanation: A company that engages in import/export and international trade. Japanese trading companies (especially 総合商社) are distinctive corporate entities that trade in a vast range of goods and invest globally.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{商社|しょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To get a job at a major trading company.

examples.japanese: {商社|しょうしゃ}マン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}{出張|しゅっちょう}→海外出張：24173_kaigaishucchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Trading company employees travel abroad frequently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧{商社|しょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}く→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: Japan's general trading companies deal in a wide range of goods, from natural resources to food products.

notes: A key concept in Japanese business. ⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧{商社|しょうしゃ} (general trading companies) such as {三菱商事|みつびししょうじ}, {三井物産|みついぶっさん}, and {伊藤忠商事|いとうちゅうしょうじ} are among Japan's largest corporations. ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{商社|しょうしゃ} (specialized trading companies) focus on specific industries. The informal term {商社|しょうしゃ}マン refers to employees of trading companies. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{勝者|しょうしゃ}→勝者：15630_shousha⟧ (winner).
